item.title: Started PhD
item.description: Started my PhD in CS at Purdue, to work on Planning for Robotics, at the CoMMA lab with Prof. Zachary Kingston.

item.title: Paper Accepted at RSS 2024
item.description: Our most recent work, titled “Motion Planning in Foliated Manifolds using Repetition Roadmap” has been accepted at Robot Science and Systems (RSS) 2024 held in Delft, Netherlands. Was presented on July 16, 2024. The conference paper can be found at Link

item.title: Presented at IRC 2023
item.description: Presented our work titled ‘Household navigation and manipulation for everyday object rearrangement tasks’, at the IEEE Robotic Computing (IRC) Conference 2023. The pre-print can be found at arXiv

item.title: Software Engineer at Aurora
item.description: Joined Aurora Tech as a software engineer, developing safe and robust perception systems for the self-driving stack

item.title: Graduated from UC San Diego!
item.description: Graduated from UC San Diego with a masters in Computer Science and Engineering, with a specialization in robotics. Cheers to an amazing two years!

item.title: Presented my thesis!
item.description: Presented my masters thesis, titled “Improvisational Robot Tool Use using Affordance based Planning”, to my committee and a public audience.
